description: This source file defines the NamedTransactionalStateStorageFactory class, which implements INamedTransactionalStateStorageFactory. It provides mechanisms to create transactional state storage instances based on service contexts, either by retrieving existing storage factories or grain storage providers.

classes.name: NamedTransactionalStateStorageFactory
classes.description: Factory class that creates transactional state storage instances based on service context and storage names.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an instance of ITransactionalStateStorage<TState> using either a factory service or a grain storage provider, based on the provided storage name.

methods.name: NamedTransactionalStateStorageFactory
methods.description: Constructors initializing the factory with a grain context accessor, with an obsolete overload including a logger factory.
